title: 问候与自我介绍
goal: 认识新朋友时能介绍自己：名字、来自哪里、做什么工作、住在哪，并且会反问对方。
tips: 初次见面说 Nice to meet you.，告别时说 Nice meeting you. / It was nice to meet you.
介绍完自己，用 How about you? / And you? 把问题抛回去，对话就能继续。
What do you do? 问的是职业，不是“你在干什么”。

exchanges.hear: Hi, I'm Tom. What's your name?
exchanges.hearZh: 你好，我是汤姆。你叫什么名字？
exchanges.reply: Hi Tom, I'm Chen. Nice to meet you.
exchanges.replyZh: 你好汤姆，我是陈。很高兴认识你。

exchanges.reply: I'm from Chengdu, in the southwest of China.
exchanges.replyZh: 我是成都人，在中国西南部。

exchanges.hear: What do you do for a living?
exchanges.reply: I'm a nurse. I work at a hospital.

exchanges.hear: How long have you lived here?

exchanges.reply: Yes, I'm married with one kid.
I live near the city center.

exchanges.hear: Is Chen your first name or your last name?
exchanges.reply: It's my last name. My first name is Jing.
exchanges.replyZh: 是我的姓，我的名字是静。

exchanges.hearZh: 很高兴认识你。（告别时说）
exchanges.reply: Nice meeting you too. See you around.

lines.en: Hi! I don't think we've met. I'm Sarah.
lines.zh: 嗨！我们好像还没见过。我是萨拉。

lines.en: Hi Sarah, I'm Jing. Nice to meet you.
lines.zh: 你好萨拉，我是静。很高兴认识你。

lines.en: Nice to meet you too. Where are you from?
lines.zh: 我也很高兴认识你。你是哪里人？

lines.en: I'm from Chengdu, in China. How about you?
I'm from Toronto. What do you do?
lines.zh: 我是多伦多人。你做什么工作？

lines.en: I'm an engineer. I work for a car company.
lines.zh: 我是工程师，在一家汽车公司工作。

lines.en: Oh, interesting. How do you know Mike?
lines.zh: 哦，挺有意思。你怎么认识迈克的？

lines.en: We work together. He's my colleague.
lines.zh: 我们一起工作，他是我同事。

lines.en: Cool. Well, it was nice meeting you, Jing.
lines.zh: 好呀。那么，很高兴认识你，静。

lines.en: You too, Sarah. See you later.
